description:
Change a saved chart, table or dataset in place. The id stays the same, so links and references keep working. Pass the id and only the fields to change. Needs the Pro plan.
Charts and tables: title, kind ("chart" or "table"), indicator, places, from, to, frequency; null clears from, to or frequency. Example: {"id": "wsp_3f9a...", "places": ["Texas", "California", "Florida"], "from": null}.
Datasets: title, description (null clears it), columns, rows. Rows replace all existing rows; send columns too when their number changes.
Returns {id, kind, title, size_bytes, created_at, updated_at, warnings?}.

from.description: First period, or null to clear.

indicator.description: Indicator id from search_indicators, for example "population", "registered_unemployment_rate", "unemployment_rate", "cpi_annual_change", "net_income_per_person".

kind.description: Charts and tables only: switch how the view is shown.

items.description: Place name or id. Examples: "Mataró", "Barcelona", "provincia de Barcelona", "Cataluña", "España", "Germany", "EU", "es-mun-08121", "08121" (INE code), "ES51" (NUTS), "Texas", "Travis County, Texas", "us-county-48453", "fips:48453" (US county FIPS), "Austin, TX", "us-place-4805000", "fips:4805000" (US city GEOID).

to.description: Last period, or null to clear.

name: workspace_update
title: Change a workspace item
